verdict.rationale: Sill states it is free and open source, and its public GitHub repository documents building from source with SwiftPM, running the host via `swift run`, and changing the bundle identifier. This shows the source is readable and buildable. Missing for 10: the specific open-source license (name or terms) is not identified in the evidence, and there is no independent corroboration of the licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Sill is free and open source.
and you can also build it from source (below).
This builds Sill.app with SwiftPM, signs it with your Apple Development identity, replaces /Applications/Sill.app and opens it.
`swift run -c release SillHost` runs the same host on the command line
